summary: An immoral woman leads a man to destruction as an ox to the slaughter—The house of an adulterous woman is the way to hell.
meta_description: An immoral woman leads a man to destruction as an ox to the slaughter—The house of an adulterous woman is the way to hell.

footnotes.note14_a: IE She cynically suggests her piety.
footnotes.note17_a: The Hebrew probably indicates a fragrant wood.
